content: For this study, we use a state-of-the-art NMT model, Transformer BIBREF8 , that uses positional encoding and self attention mechanism to achieve three benefits over the existing convolutional or recurrent neural network based models: (a) reduced computational complexity of each layer, (b) parallel computation, and (c) path length between long-range dependencies.
